title: MONUSCO irregular medical-insurance claim controls
decision_reason: Retained governing-text extraction identifies a review/control mechanism; underlying complete operational records, accountable owner confirmation and financial validation are absent.
current_arrangement: The retained A/RES/80/278 paragraph 9 extraction requests stronger controls over irregular medical-insurance claims. Paragraphs 10–11 preserve mandate capability and medical-emergency readiness. No patient-level claims or adjudications are in the public corpus.
testable_mechanism: Test whether eligibility, duplicate-claim and reimbursement checks prevent unsupported payments without delaying legitimate care. A flag is not fraud and a repeated amount is not a duplicate without claim-level linkage.
feasible_alternative_to_test: Owner-approved confidential claim adjudication and control redesign, with expedited clinical exceptions and appeal review; retain necessary care and emergency evacuation capacity.
safeguards: Timely medically necessary care and emergency evacuation
Patient confidentiality, minimum necessary data and clinical independence
Fair review, appeal and no automatic denial from algorithmic flags
cost_perimeter_and_nonadditivity: Separate prevention, correction and recovery. Count only supported overpayments or avoided future payments against a valid counterfactual, net of administration and delayed-care costs. Provider, insurer and mission reimbursements can represent one episode; reconcile once. No medical claim exposure or recovery is estimated.
minimum_records: Pseudonymized episode/claim IDs, eligibility dates and approved coverage rules
Provider invoice, service date, procedure category, authorization and insurer adjudication
Payment, reversal, reimbursement and recovery links with appeal outcome
Control timestamps, care-delay indicators, exception handling and independent clinical review
custodian_roles_to_confirm: Authorized insurer claims and mission finance custodians
Independent medical reviewer and privacy/information-security role

source_snapshot.directive_paraphrase: Strengthen internal controls for irregular medical insurance claims
Ensure adequate resources for efficient and effective permanent-ceasefire support consistent with Security Council 2808
Maintain readiness and logistical flexibility for medical emergencies

source_snapshot.decision_guardrail: The GA inclusive appropriation includes shared support UNLB and RSCE; adopted_minus_proposed compares GA mission-maintenance gross against SG mission-maintenance gross; no new savings inferred

case_specific_limit: No live medical records should enter Git. Public derivatives must suppress patient identifiers and rare combinations that could reidentify individuals; the project has no access authorization.
source_review_scope: Retained repository extractions; primary resolution bytes are not newly authenticated and no current implementation or compliance determination is made.
handling: Use approved restricted intake, minimum necessary fields and pseudonymization; no live financial, personnel, medical or security-sensitive records in this public repository.
reopen_condition: Confirmed accountable owner and authorized complete linked records permit a validation-ready assessment; a draft request is not authority or evidence receipt.
